cards.t: Winklevoss Twins File for Spot Zcash ETF on Nasdaq
cards.b: Winklevoss Asset Services has filed an S-1 with the SEC for a spot Zcash ETF to trade on Nasdaq under the ticker WINK with a 0.25% annual fee. This filing follows a sharp rise in Zcash prices and aims to compete with existing products by offering a lower fee structure.

per.ZEC: Filing of the WINK spot ETF on Nasdaq could drive institutional inflows and trading volume.

cards.label: STRONG CATALYST
cards.missing: Exact launch date and SEC approval timeline are not specified.

cards.t: Arbitrum Launches Paxos USDG Stablecoin with ARB Incentives
cards.b: Arbitrum has joined the Paxos-led Global Dollar group, bringing the USDG stablecoin live on its network. The Layer-2 network has proposed 100 million ARB in incentives to support adoption, liquidity, and secure a share of reserve income.

per.ARB: Incentives and integration of the USDG stablecoin aim to drive ecosystem activity and adoption.
per.USDG: Expansion onto Arbitrum broadens the stablecoin's multi-chain distribution.

cards.label: COMPLETED CATALYST
cards.missing: Timeline for rolling out the 100 million ARB incentives.

cards.t: Ethereum Sepolia Testnet Successfully Runs Glamsterdam Upgrade
cards.b: Ethereum deployed its Glamsterdam upgrade on the Sepolia testnet following a last-minute validator client software fix. The upgrade serves as a major rehearsal for mainnet activation, designed to boost capacity by raising block work limits to 200 million gas.

per.ETH: Successful testnet execution paves the way for a major capacity and efficiency jump on the mainnet.

cards.label: COMPLETED CATALYST
cards.missing: Exact mainnet activation date for the Glamsterdam upgrade.
